slots.name: Talarico total raised
slots.sentence: Talarico, a Democratic darling, has become a fundraising powerhouse in his own right, raising $68.6 million through June 30 and ending the quarter with $21.5 million in cash, according to FEC filings.

slots.name: highest raising candidates count
slots.sentence: He’s hardly alone. The FEC currently lists Democrats Jon Ossoff, Talarico and Sherrod Brown as the cycle’s three highest-raising Senate candidates.

slots.name: Democratic total cash on hand
slots.sentence: Across seven key Senate races, Democrats entered July with $74.7 million in cash, more than double Republicans' $36.8 million, according to a CNBC analysis of FEC filings through June 30.
